title: Fuel Price Increase Affecting Delivery Cost
description: Diesel prices surged 23% in the last quarter, significantly impacting logistics and last-mile delivery costs.
input: Logistics Cost Alert: Diesel fuel prices have increased 23% over the past 90 days, from $3.45/gallon to $4.24/gallon. Impact assessment: (1) Average delivery cost per order increased from $8.50 to $10.20 (+20%). (2) Fleet operating costs rose by $340K/month across 120 vehicles. (3) Current delivery pricing absorbs only 60% of actual cost — margin erosion of $2.04 per delivery. (4) Competitors have already raised delivery fees by $1.50-$2.00. (5) Customer complaints about delivery times increased 15% as drivers optimize routes for fuel efficiency over speed.
expectedInsights: 23% fuel cost increase creating $2.04/delivery margin erosion
Competitors already adjusted pricing — window to act
Route optimization impacting delivery speed and satisfaction
